title: AI usage ingest v1: one usage record
description: The full totals of one bucket: one session of one tool with one model on one UTC day. Sending a record again replaces the totals stored for its idempotency key; it never adds to them.

idempotency_key.description: Names the bucket for its target user. Printable ASCII without spaces. Recommended: the lower-case hex SHA-256 of 'v1|<tool>|<session_id>|<model>|<usage_date>'.

tool.description: Slug of the AI tool, e.g. claude-code, codex, gemini-cli. An unknown slug is added to Specivo as an inactive tool.

tool_version.description: Version of the tool. Informational; v1 servers do not store it.

provider.description: Model provider, e.g. anthropic, openai, google. Defaults to the tool's provider.

model.description: Model name as the tool reports it. Provider prefixes such as 'anthropic/' are stripped.

session_id.description: Opaque id of the tool's session. Stored as is; never parsed.

usage_date.description: The UTC day of the bucket (YYYY-MM-DD). Not in the future and at most 400 days old.

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the person, e.g. Asia/Bangkok. Informational; v1 servers do not store it.

started_at.description: First activity in the bucket. Must fall on usage_date (UTC). Prices are taken at this instant.

ended_at.description: Last activity in the bucket: not before started_at, and no later than the end of usage_date (00:00 UTC of the next day).

tokens.description: Token totals of the bucket. 'input' excludes cache reads and writes.

long_context_tokens.description: The part of 'tokens' billed at long-context prices, when the provider has them.

reported_cost.description: What the provider charged, when the tool knows it. Used as the spend of 'api' usage; stored but not used for other cost types.

cost_type.description: How the usage is paid. Omitted or null: the server uses the user's AI subscription covering the tool, else 'unknown'.

subscription_hint.description: Plan the tool reports, e.g. claude-max-20x. Informational; v1 servers do not store it.

on_behalf_of.description: Login of the person the usage belongs to, when it is not the account that sends the batch.

instant.description: RFC 3339 timestamp with a time zone offset ('Z' or '+07:00').

tokens.description: Token counts by class; a missing class is 0.

amount.description: Non-negative decimal as a string, at most 12 integer and 8 fractional digits.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code the server knows (GET /api/v1/ai-usage/ingest lists them).

attribution.description: Hints for the issue and project the usage belongs to. See the README for the order in which they are tried.

issue_ref.description: Issue the person named, e.g. ACME-12. Explicit: refused when it cannot be used.

issue_ref_source.description: Where issue_ref came from: 'env' for the SPECIVO_ISSUE environment variable, 'explicit' (the default) otherwise.

project_key.description: Project the person named, e.g. ACME. Explicit: refused when it cannot be used.

git_branch.description: Branch checked out during the session. Stored; an issue key in it (feat/acme-12-login) is a hint.

repo.description: Repository of the working directory: 'github.com/acme/app', a clone URL or 'acme/app'. Stored; matched against connected repositories.

commits.description: Full SHAs of commits made during the session (40 or 64 hex digits).
